author: felicepantaleo
body:
The CMS GEN group asked for a way to produce the MC-truth graph in a job that runs only the GEN step. This PR adds that option.

- `TruthGraphProducer` reads no SIM product when the `simTracks` and `simVertices` tags are empty. The default tags stay `g4SimHits`, so the DIGI build does not change.
- In this mode the producer throws an exception when it finds no GEN record. Without this check, a wrong GEN tag gives an empty graph and no message.
- `PhysicsTools/TruthInfo/python/customiseTruthGenOnly.py` adds `truthGenOnlyGraphProducer` and `truthGenOnlyLogicalGraphProducer` to the GEN step, and every EDM output module keeps their products, except the LHE stream (it also writes the events that the GEN step rejects). The logical graph uses the same settings as at DIGI, but the pruning of particles without hits is off.
- Usage: `cmsDriver.py ... -s GEN --customise PhysicsTools/TruthInfo/customiseTruthGenOnly.customiseTruthGenOnly`.

This PR also adds run metadata of the truth graph, behind an option. The option is off by default.

- New run product `truth::GraphMetadata` (SimDataFormats/TruthInfo), written once per run by `TruthGraphMetadataProducer` with the label `truthGraphMetadata`.
- It holds the build mode (`GenOnly`, `GenSim` without pile-up, `GenSimMixed` with pile-up input; `Unknown` with a warning), the pile-up bunch crossings, the release, the generator (module type, release and configuration from the process history; program name, version and fragment from the configuration), the selection and pruning settings with the preset name, the name of each level bit, the hit-index channels and inputs, and the energy unit of each subdetector.
- The producer reads the parameter sets of the modules that ran, in this job and in the jobs before it, so the metadata cannot drift from the configuration. A later job can write the metadata of a file it reads. A parameter that the earlier job did not have keeps its default value, so files of older releases work.
- `customiseTruthMetadata` turns it on in a job that builds the graph at DIGI, and needs exactly one graph producer in the job; `addTruthMetadata` takes explicit labels. `customiseTruthGenOnlyWithMetadata` turns it on in a GEN-only job.
- The generator program, its version and the fragment name are in no parameter set. The customise fills them only when the same job runs the generator: the version from the scram toolbox file of the release, the fragment from the cmsDriver annotation. In a DIGI job they are empty.
- Two files of the same run with different metadata: the framework keeps the first and logs an error (`isProductEqual`).
- `applyTruthPreset` now sets every `TruthLogicalGraphProducer`, found by type, so a preset also applies to the GEN-only graph. It records the preset name in the new `postProcessing.presetName` parameter, which the selection does not read.
- The per-event seed fields of `truth::Graph` do not change.

The graph holds every GEN particle and vertex of the record, with the full decay chain and the parton shower. It holds no SIM particle, no hit index and no GEN to SIM link. All levels are filled, except `caloBoundary`, which needs the SIM and is empty.
title: Truth graph in a GEN-only job, and run metadata of the graph
